data: :[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #4 is coming in 3 minutes! Hey Tenno! We’re back to remove Höllars Caches as a reward from all the Hell-Scrub and Legacyte Harvest mission rotations. I wonder if On-Lyne is looking for a ghost writer, I have a great song idea that goes something like “I hollar, you hollar, they hollar, we all hollar.” Don’t laugh, it’s a work in progress…

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #4 is coming in 2 minutes! We fixed Steel Path difficulty modifiers applying twice on the Faceoff Assassination targets. This was extremely noticeable on the Techrot Babau. You can say byebau to the Babau, because that three legged abomination is no longer gonna whoop your butt as bad.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #4 is coming in 1 minute! Fixed Nyx’s Psychic Bolts Max Armor Cap not scaling with Ability Strength. Like Psychic Bolts, I am seeking Chemistry with Quincy using my telekinetic precision. Shooting my shot as the kids say.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #4 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #4 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #5 is coming in 3 minutes! We added a Lock and a Note for when you cannot upgrade Chemistry, due to needing a rank up in the Hex Syndicate. If only I had notes pop-up like this for real life, maybe my dating life wouldn’t be quite as painful as it is.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #5 is coming in 2 minutes! Added a ‘!’ indicator on Steel Path 1999 Nodes if you still need to complete nodes on Normal mode before progression is tracked. A ‘!’ indicator would come in handy in real life - give me one of those before I make a mistake. Like that time I forgot to correctly label the dog’s peanut butter and ate it by mistake.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #5 is coming in 1 minute! Fixed the 1999 Calendar not displaying the current date when all calendar events had been completed. Knowing the current date really helps keep track of the important things. Like missed anniversaries, and birthdays, oh- remembering when I had my vacation planned!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #5 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #5 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #7 is coming in 3 minutes! Happy Tuesday, Tenno! We reduced the distance at which Legacytes can spawn in Legacyte Harvest missions, so you don’t have to hike as far to find them. My cardiovascular system and knees are relieved, I don’t do that whole running thing.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #7 is coming in 2 minutes! We fixed your Drifter looking off in the New Year’s Eve kiss cinematics. Thank goodness, because I didn’t want the Hex thinking I catfished them over the internets. Your next opportunity for a kiss will be on the February 9th year reset! So get those Drifters to the salons!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #7 is coming in 1 minute! We also fixed Caliban’s Conculysts ending their whirlwind attack early for Clients. They can now properly live out their ballerina fantasies, as is their right.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #7 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Warframe: 1999: Hotfix #7 has been deployed. Restart to receive!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :heyyyyy

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #8 is coming in 3 minutes! Ironclad? More like Ironchad. Rhino’s Heirloom collection has arrived! Upgrade your fashion with the Rhino Heirloom Skin, Signa, Sigil, & more. I’ve heard a lot about “horn-y” fashion frame recently, and now I realize it was all in anticipation of the new Horns-like Signa. You guys are so smart. Not sure why you also said that about Ember Heirloom though…

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #8 is coming in 2 minutes! After decking out your Rhino — including the new Iron Skin Overrides in your Auxiliary attachments — don’t forget to visit Ticker in Fortuna to celebrate Star Days. Regardless of your relationship status, everyone is deserving of love this Star Days season (my ex-wife excluded), so be sure to check out her wares to spread the festive cheer!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #8 is coming in 1 minute! Don’t forget to spend the last of your Nightwave Creds before Nora’s Mix Vol. 8 kicks off at 2pm ET today. Hoarding all of your Creds feels great in the moment until you forget to use them before it’s too late and then they serve as a reminder of everything you promised you’d do but never got around to in this relentless passage of time. Yay, new Nightwave!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #8 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #8 has been deployed. Restart to receive! Nightwave Vol. 8 begins at 2:15pm ET later today!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :iOS players: the Hotfix JUST deployed for you! Please restart to receive if you're on iOS!

:[DE]Dani!540db9a33846322663b42f52@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #9 is coming in 3 minutes! A few offset tweaks incoming for the Rhino Heirloom Skin! Not that he wasn’t perfect before — now he’s even more perfecter. The perfectedest Warframe of all. Please don’t send this to any English teachers you know. I’m not responsible for the resulting aneurysms.

:[DE]Dani!540db9a33846322663b42f52@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #9 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed Wood Floor colors also applying to the Curtains in the Backroom. Thank Sol the floor wasn’t carpeted, otherwise the jokes may have gotten out of hand.

:[DE]Dani!540db9a33846322663b42f52@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #9 is coming in 1 minute! Iron Skin now uses the VFX of your equipped Rhino Skin if you’re not using an Iron Skin Override. For a brief moment, having “None” auxiliary would use the default Rhino Iron Skin VFX regardless of the skin equipped. The skin for your skin is now determined by your skin, provided you have not overridden your skin — capiche?
:[DE]Dani!540db9a33846322663b42f52@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #9 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Dani!540db9a33846322663b42f52@warframe.com WALLOPS :Rhino Heirloom: Hotfix #9 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #10 is coming in 3 minutes! Lavo Prime is here! Armed with both Cedo Prime and Dual Zoren Prime, our self-Primed king also comes with the Nimandi Prime Armor, Vitam Prime Syandana, and Transmutation Probe Prime decoration.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #10 is coming in 2 minutes! Dual Zoren Prime brings a throwback to Coptering with its unique trait: gain a burst of speed on mid-air slide attacks. Those who were around when Coptering first appeared, how’s that lower back feeling? Got any aches and pains you wanna complain about? Consider this practice for your next physical.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #10 is coming in 1 minute! Speaking of back pain, we fixed the Techrot faction buff unintentionally applying to stage 2 of the Efervon Tank fight. If you were struggling in the second half of the fight, this may be why. For those who earned an Apex Tank Accolade while this was live, you’re built different and should be proud.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #10 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #10 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #11 is coming in 3 minutes! Happy Valentine’s Day, Tenno! Did you get me anything? A bouquet of Moonlight Dragonlillies? Some Polyp-Hog Truffles? A picture of Arthur in a maid costume? They were sold out of everything when I went to the store, but I brought you something even more special: a Hotfix!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #11 is coming in 2 minutes! What’s more romantic than a bunch of 1s and 0s? Well, my ex-wife called me a zero, and she didn’t find me romantic at all. Anyway — we fixed some things! 1999 Calendar tasks no longer reset on the first try, and Cavia Syndicate rank-ups will now play cutscenes again, just to name a few.

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #11 is coming in 1 minute! We also snuck in some QOL: Techrot and Melica Cache waypoints are now map-wide if they’re Bounty objectives. Kubrows will also bark happily when they open lockers using the Scavenge Precept, and won’t just stand there listening to the voices in their head before attempting to open them. Good boy!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #11 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #11 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #12 is coming in 3 minutes! Increased the Void Tear spawn rate in Excavation missions with only a single dig site active. This should mean more Reactant for players who carefully manage their dig sites for Relic rotations — unlike me, who spawns them all at once and lets only the strongest ones survive. Why yes, my friends are always too busy to play Excavation with me, why do you ask?

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #12 is coming in 2 minutes! Reduced the Cedo Prime glaive speed to 75m/s, since it’s actually possible to go TOO fast in Warframe. Looks like we had our testing settings tuned to Amir instead of normal mortals. ROBOTS ROBOTS ROBOTS RO-

:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #12 is coming in 1 minute! Fixed Acolytes not spawning in Steel Path 1999 missions if started from the Höllvania Central Mall. If you ask me, they probably saw the Mall on the way and decided to hang out with the Hex instead. Get rejected by Eleanor (again) or be insta-deleted by a dripped-out Dante? Hard to decide!
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #12 is deploying now! Remain sat in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5208fcb41a4d80e407000033@warframe.com WALLOPS :Lavos Prime: Hotfix #12 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is coming in 5 minutes! The floor shakes and the crowd cheers for more – It’s Techrot Encore! Our first major update of 2025 is here and is more stacked than your dad’s record collection.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is coming in 4 minutes! Welcome to the stage… Temple! The 60th Warframe is here to set the scene on fire with their Exalted Guitar Lizzie and their Flare for performance. Speaking of performance, protect Temple as they shred in the new Stage Defense mission in Höllvania! You’ll also be able to earn their Blueprints and more by clearing waves of Scaldra and a new enemy… the Scaldra Screamer.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is coming in 3 minutes! The cast of Höllvania Central Mall grows with a new rebellious group of Protoframes – meet & greet Minerva (Saryn), Velimir (Frost), Kaya (Nova) and Flare (Temple) at The Round Table pub! They bring with them many wares for you to acquire. Their fully voiced and customizable Gemini Skins and Emotes are also now available for their respective Warframes.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is coming in 2 minutes! The setlist continues with the Technocyte Coda, a new Adversary system that features a multi-talented Techrot boyband virus. Chase them down for new Ephemeras, Dance Emotes and more! There are also 13 Coda Weapons available for you to earn from Eleanor.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is coming in 1 minute! Visit Kaya to step into Temporal Archimedea – a re-imagination of Deep Archimedea. Give yourself a boost with Peely Pix, special stickers you can slap for various unique effects. And so so so much more! We have Ollie’s Crash Course (new Atomicycle racing mini-game), Gyre Vortengeist Collection, TennoGen, Exalted Weapon Changes, Ash Retouch, and more.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Update 38.5: Techrot Encore has been deployed. Restart to receive if you have not already! If you've already grabbed the update you can ignore me okay love you bye

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #1 is coming in 3 minutes! Sorry to break up the party at The Round Table but we’ve got a juicy hotfix for y’all! We’ll try to make this quick so you can go back to ogling— UH, chatting with the new Protoframes in Höllvania Central Mall.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #1 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed Potency Mods having incorrect Drop Tables. I’m afraid of germs like the next Tenno (excluding Eleanor daters, of course), but we all probably don’t need that many Immuno Shields. Our drop table site will be updated with correct values a few minutes after this hotfix pops.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #1 is coming in 1 minute! You’ll no longer see “zombie” Antivirus Mod Bounties that cause your game to crash or freeze up. I knew the boyband business was vicious, but breaking the Bounties that could help take them down? The Technocyte Coda are crafty indeed.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #1 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #1 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #2 is coming in 3 minutes! Temporal Archimedea now has fully built Omni Forma in the Gold and Diamond Reward Pools. Omni Forma in the Silver Reward Pool remains a Blueprint, with its rarity adjusted to match the Tauforged Shard rewards.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #2 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed enemies failing to spawn in Stage Defense, resulting in eeeextra long waves. Seems like they were too busy rocking out to Temple and the Rippers to make an appearance — either way, the mission will now progress properly even if they decided to press “replay” too many times.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #2 is coming in 1 minute! Arcane Hotshot and Arcane Universal Fallout now apply to Exalted Weapon Status Effects. Mesa mains rejoice, this means it’ll work on your rooty-tooty-pointy-and-shooties (or, if you prefer to use its government name, her Peacemakers).
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #2 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #2 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #3 is coming in 3 minutes! We’ve removed 1999, Zariman, and Albrecht’s Labs nodes from Steel Path and Arbitration requirements. Now you only need to complete up until The New War to unlock these new mission types. Whether your builds are up to snuff for this content is another question entirely. In the immortal words of Teshin: “skill issue, Tenno”.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #3 is coming in 2 minutes! Re-enabled Technocyte Coda trading as we have fixed traded Codas not progressing properly. Tell your offline friends that you can trade boyband members in Warframe and see how that conversation goes.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #3 is coming in 1 minute! Added a metronome SFX to Temple’s Backbeat to help you stay on beat. If you’re already rhythmically gifted or simply want to turn the sound off, you can do so in Temple’s Abilities screen.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #3 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #3 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #4 is coming in 3 minutes! We’ve temporarily disabled the “Auto-Disband” feature as it could cause players to lose function after leaving missions. We are re-assessing the feature for a future Cert build launch.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #4 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed Temple’s passive not working in Höllvania missions after the addition of the new metronome SFX. Our mistake for updating their kit without asking Lizzie first. I’m sorry, Lizzie! WAIT, NO OW—

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #4 is coming in 1 minute! The ground will now properly break if a host migration occurs on Wave 3 of Stage Defense. Next top issue to solve is that pesky staircase plant right?...
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #4 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #4 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Dani!DEDani@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #5 is coming in 3 minutes! Auto-Disband is back, baby! We temporarily turned off this mechanic with yesterday’s hotfix as it was causing players to lose function when returning from missions — but now it’s back and better than ever (ie. hopefully doesn’t break the game). We’ll be on the lookout for new reports in case it starts misbehaving again.

:[DE]Dani!DEDani@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #5 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed cases of enemies spawning reeeeally far away in Stage Defense missions. Clearly not Temple & the Rippers fans, amirite? Now they’ll spawn exclusively in the objective tile so they can be lulled by Temple’s musical prowess while you dispatch them.

:[DE]Dani!DEDani@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #5 is coming in 1 minute! Added waypoints to Pheroglands in Legacyte Harvest missions so players know to pick them up and bring them to Kalymos. Nothing like a yummy Techrot snack to speed up the Legacyte hunt. Mmm, soooo tasty!
:[DE]Dani!DEDani@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #5 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Dani!DEDani@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #5 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #6 is coming in 3 minutes! We’re adding a Void-Swept version of the TennoCon Riftguard Syandana, so it can permanently swoopy without the need for an emote. Tenno who currently own the Digital Pack will see the Void-Swept item after downloading this Hotfix!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #6 is coming in 2 minutes! Lettie and Amir will yap less in Hell-scrub missions — i.e. we’ve reduced the frequency of their transmissions after player feedback. The less we hear about Amir leaving chili con carne in the fridge for 2 MONTHS, the better. I don’t know if we can ever forgive him for that.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #6 is coming in 1 minute! Temporal Archimedea enjoyers will now earn 15,000 Hex Syndicate standing on their first completion each week. That’s basically three traffic cones, meaning lots and lots of hats for Kalymos (and your Floofs, of course!).
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #6 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #6 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #7 is coming in 3 minutes! Taking down Technocyte Coda in a squad will now earn you 1 extra Live Heartcell per Boyband you defeat in a Showdown. Team of 4? That’s three extra Live Heartcells, baby. Don’t spend them all in one place. Actually, there’s only one place you can spend so forget I said that.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #7 is coming in 2 minutes! We’ve removed the “feet planted” requirement for the High Ground Bounty challenge in 1999 Bounties. This means those grippers can be airborne for your kills to count — that’s right chat, air those bad boys out. Please don’t make me regret typing this.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #7 is coming in 1 minute! Does anything even matter anymore after I said “grippers”? Are you even reading this? We fixed a bunch of other stuff too, y’know: Kaya’s hair tint is back, lots of Coda Showdown bugs, missing 1999 Steel Path trophies. Lots of great non-foot related things, I swear.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #7 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #7 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #8 is coming in 3 minutes! A Friday fixin?! Say it ain't so. Fixed Technocyte Coda Duets consistently not spawning despite being at 100% Spawn Chance. The odds were not in your favor after all.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #8 is coming in 2 minutes! Fixed Minerva Gemini Skin's legs being unlit. Show me those gams, girl.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #8 is coming in 1 minute! Fixed Scourge's Alt Fire not proc’ing for Clients. Proc and Rock, baby.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #8 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #8 has been deployed. Restart to receive! Happy Friyay!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #9 is coming in 3 minutes! Happy Monday, Tenno! We’re kicking off the week with another hotfix — shout out to the teams working behind the scenes on these back-to-back patches. All I gotta do is sit here and type into a chatbox. Although, trying to appease Region Chat may be the hardest job of all.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #9 is coming in 2 minutes! Speaking of patches, we’re changing the capacity cost of Primed Steady Hands from 16 to 12. That bad boy was a little too big, it should slide nice and easy into your builds now.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #9 is coming in 1 minute! Minerva’s Gemini skin will let you customize the Techrot sections once more. I’m sure Velimir thought she was beautiful regardless — but the rest of y’all? Fashion frame is clearly no joke.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #9 is deploying now! Remain in your missions until this is complete.
:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #9 has been deployed. Restart to receive!

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #10 is coming in 3 minutes! Last week was a good week for Gauss and Atlas players — now it’s time for Dante players to get a win! We’ve fixed Noctua’s seeking projectiles not actually dealing damage. The power of a good Book.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #10 is coming in 2 minutes! Our resident boyband loves spawning into the loading tunnel no matter how many times we’ve tried to fix it. Now if they break the rules and show up where they’re not supposed to, they’ll be teleported out and put back into the mission where they belong.

:[DE]Megan!5078481b1a@warframe.com WALLOPS :Techrot Encore: Hotfix #10 is coming in 1 minute! It also turns out that the Crescent Charge Precept was causing Technocyte Coda to be ragdolled permanently, meaning you often wouldn’t be able to stab them in the Showdown. I too would prefer to play dead if facing off against a Warframe and their giant-infested cat.
